decisions.reason: As a new facial care line very close to the firm's established natural skincare know-how and given visible website support with its own page, management would likely keep it and refine it rather than withdraw it.

A hyaluronic facial serum fits the firm's core product and ingredient knowledge, so even without explicit R&D information its related expertise makes continued learning and commercial improvement likely.

Facial cleansing milk is strongly related to the firm's existing skincare range, and in a growing industry the firm would usually retain such a familiar product unless clear negative evidence appeared.
